mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Defines network transport protocol mode for receiving syslog messages.

port.title: Port
port.description: TCP/UDP port to listen for incoming connections.

buffer_chunk_size.title: Buffer Chunk Size
buffer_chunk_size.description: Buffer size for incoming syslog messages. For UDP mode, this is the only way to configure receive buffer.

buffer_max_size.title: Buffer Max Size
buffer_max_size.description: Maximum buffer size to receive a syslog message. Defaults to buffer_chunk_size if not set.

receive_buffer_size.title: Receive Buffer Size
receive_buffer_size.description: Maximum socket receive buffer size. Important for high-volume UDP to prevent message loss. On Linux, capped by sysctl net.core.rmem_max.

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: Alternative parser for the message. Default is syslog-rfc5424 for tcp/udp. Use syslog-rfc5424 for fractional seconds.

raw_message_key.title: Raw Message Key
raw_message_key.description: Key where the original raw syslog message will be preserved.

source_address_key.title: Source Address Key
source_address_key.description: Key where the source address will be injected.

threaded.title: Threaded
threaded.description: Run this input plugin in its own thread.
